contract_name: ORBIT-FMIB CODE 14 — CROSSED DELETE-ONE-AA CANDIDATE DESIGN
purpose: Define dependence-aware leave-one-amino-acid-identity perturbations on the observed GB1 strict cube support for computational validation before any formal inferential combination rule is authorized.
dependency_rule: Deleting one amino-acid identity removes every existing strict cube containing that identity at that biological position. Cubes sharing the deleted identity therefore move together.

estimator_partition.rule: For a deletion, preserve each surviving cube's original corrected-IID estimator partition membership; do not repartition surviving cubes.

computational_pilot.reason: Most aggressive observed validation-set deletion in the feasibility audit.
computational_pilot.scope: Computational validation only. Results must not be used as an inferential replicate or included in any final CI, p-value, tail probability, or significance claim.

formal_inference.rule: A separate inferential implementation contract specifying the mathematically justified multiway identity jackknife or alternative dependence-aware inference rule must be frozen before any inferential runs.

superseded_designs: Four-way product-multiplicity identity bootstrap is not authorized for MINE refitting because its audit produced severely reduced effective estimator sample sizes.
